name: io.github.andreymudri/vault-mcp
description: Long-term memory for a coding agent: searches your Obsidian vault and cites path:line.

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the root folder of the Obsidian vault to serve. Required; the server exits with a message on stderr without it.

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_LANG
environmentVariables.description: Language the server speaks in tool descriptions and errors: 'en' (default) or 'pt'. It never changes what is written into the vault — commit subjects and section names follow the vault.

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_AUTO_PUSH
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to git push after each write's commit. Off by default: it is the only thing this server does that leaves the machine. A failed push is reported as a warning, never rolled back.

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to publish only the read tools: nothing in the vault can be written, moved or deleted through this server. A value that is neither a yes nor a no is treated as 1.

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_DISABLED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Tool names not to publish, separated by commas or spaces, e.g. vault_delete,vault_move.

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: How much the server writes to stderr, one JSON object per line: silent, error, warn (default), info or debug. The same events reach the client through the MCP logging capability.

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_MAX_NOTE_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Files larger than this many bytes are left out of the index and reported as a diagnostic. Default 5242880 (5 MB).

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long a write waits for another process writing the same vault before it is refused. Default 30000.
